title: WidgetConfig
description: Top-level widget config with layouts per size family.

accessory.description: iOS / watchOS Lock Screen accessory families (circular, rectangular, inline). Falls back to `small`. Ignored elsewhere. Not a resolve family: `{{…}}`, `when`, `repeat` and `entries` do not apply to it.

defaultLocale.description: Locale used when the device locale has no `strings` table. Default: first table.

entries.description: Scheduled states: from `at` on, an entry's layouts replace the base ones. The OS switches them while the app is closed (WidgetKit timeline, Android alarm, desktop timer). See [`crate::resolve`].

fallback.description: Layouts shown by renderers that do not meet `requires`.

large.description: Layout for the large size family.

medium.description: Layout for the medium size family.

requires.description: Minimum renderer contract; older renderers show `fallback` instead.

small.description: Layout for the small size family.

source.description: JSON the widget fetches by itself on a schedule; its fields are `{{data.path}}`.

state.description: Defaults of the widget's local state, read as `{{state.key}}` / `when` / `bind` / `repeat.each: "state.list"`. Taps on elements with `set` change it in-process (no app needed); `setWidgetState` changes it from the app. The stored state (`state:{widgetId}`, `state:{widgetId}#{instance}`) is merged over these per top-level key.

strings.description: Localized strings per locale (`"en"`, `"pt-BR"`), used as `{{t.key}}` in any text.

transition.description: How content changes between timeline entries / redraws (a hint): `numeric` animates digits, `opacity` cross-fades, `slide` pushes from the bottom. Apple and desktop animate; Android and Adaptive Cards ignore it.

BackgroundValue.description: Background: solid color string, adaptive pair, gradient, or material blur.

anyOf.description: Hex string or semantic color name.
Distinct colors for light and dark appearance.

color.description: Border color (hex string or semantic name).

oneOf.description: Outline in the label color, no fill.

CanvasDrawCommand.description: A single declarative draw command for [`crate::models::CanvasElement`].

oneOf.description: Text label drawn at a point.

ChartDataPoint.description: A single labeled data point for [`crate::models::ChartElement`].

series.description: Series name: points with the same `series` form one line / bar group.

ColorValue.description:
Color value — hex string, semantic name, or adaptive `{ light, dark }` pair.

Semantic names: `"label"`, `"secondaryLabel"`, `"systemBackground"`, `"secondarySystemBackground"`, `"accent"`, `"separator"`.

anyOf.description: Hex string or semantic color name.
Distinct colors for light and dark appearance.

ContentMode.description: How an image fills its frame.

oneOf.description: `stretch`: fill both axes, ignoring the aspect ratio.

DataSource.description:
Remote JSON the widget fetches without the app ([`WidgetConfig::source`]).

`url`, header values and `body` may use `{{instance}}` and `{{locale}}`, so each placement of a widget can ask for its own data.

refreshMinutes.description: Minutes between fetches. Default 30; the OS may stretch it (minimum 15).

url.description: `https://` URL returning a JSON object (at most 256 KiB).

FrameConfig.description: Explicit width / height / max-size constraints for an element.

maxHeight.description: Maximum height — a fixed point value or `"infinity"`.

maxWidth.description: Maximum width — a fixed point value or `"infinity"`.

FrameDimension.description: A frame dimension — either a fixed point value or `"infinity"`.

GradientConfig.description: Linear, radial, or angular gradient background.

endPoint.description: End point in unit space (`{x:1,y:1}` = bottom trailing).

startPoint.description: Start point in unit space (`{x:0,y:0}` = top leading); overrides `direction`.

stops.description: Colors at explicit positions (`location` 0…1); replaces `colors` when set.

GradientStop.description: A gradient color at a position.

HorizontalAlignment.description: Horizontal alignment of children within a stack.

Justify.description: Distribution of stack children along the stack axis.

oneOf.description: First and last at the edges, equal gaps between.

action.description: Action identifier — emits a `widget-action` event when tapped.

payload.description: Opaque payload forwarded alongside the action event.

PaddingValue.description: Inset padding — a single uniform value or per-edge overrides.

color.description: Shadow color (hex string or semantic name).

TextStyle.description: Semantic text style — respects Dynamic Type / accessibility settings.

oneOf.description: Push the new content in from the bottom.

TruncationMode.description: Where text is cut when it does not fit.

UnitPoint.description: A point in unit coordinates (`0…1` on both axes, origin top leading).

VerticalAlignment.description: Vertical alignment of children within a stack.

WidgetElement.description: A UI element that can be a layout container or a leaf widget.

flex.description: Layout weight for flexible sizing inside stacks (like Android `layout_weight`).

offsetY.description: Move down by points after layout (does not affect siblings).

set.description: Local state written on tap, in-process (no app needed): `{"done": "$toggle"}`. `"$toggle"` flips a boolean (missing → `true`), `"$inc"` / `"$dec"` add / subtract 1 (missing → 0 first), `null` removes the key (the default shows again), any other JSON is stored as is. With `action` too, the action is sent after the write.
